The '''PAV-11 Imperial Scout''' was a model of [[Submarine/Legends|submarine]] that was used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Third Galactic War]], including during the [[Invasion of Manaan]].<ref name="TOR" />
{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:PAV-11_Imperial_Scout.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The player speeder version of the submersible.]]
The PAV-11 Imperial Scout first appeared in the [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] [[Invasion Zone]] in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''.<ref name="TOR" /> It was later added to the game as a player mount via the [[Cartel Market]]. Although it was a submersible, this mount was used by players as a regular landspeeder mount.<ref name="Bundle" />
